zh-Hant.title: 紙與光
zh-Hant.description: 調整光的方向與色溫，觀察一張紙如何顯露纖維、摺痕和陰影。

en.title: Paper & Light
en.description: Change the direction and color of the light to study fibers, folds and shadows on one sheet.

zh-Hant.title: 流體檔案
zh-Hant.description: 三個液態金屬物件，在旋轉時顯露不同的反射與邊緣。

en.title: Liquid Archive
en.description: Three liquid-metal objects reveal different reflections and edges as they turn.

zh-Hant.title: 夜航訊號
zh-Hant.description: 一場虛構的夜間訊號展。三段節目沿著波形、斜線與網格展開。

en.title: Night Signal
en.description: An imagined after-dark broadcast in three chapters, drawn in waves, bands and a grid.
